description: Set contact extra variables. The extra variable a can be of any type and is associated with the index i as if stored in an array.

notes: Live 7.0 grammar: the optional process selector precedes the subcommand ('contact mechanical <sub>' / 'contact thermal <sub>'); it is not a keyword of the subcommand itself.

Live 9.7 grammar: the optional process selector precedes the subcommand ('contact mechanical <sub>' / 'contact thermal <sub>' / 'contact fluid <sub>' - fluid is 9.x-new); it is not a keyword of the subcommand itself.
